name: concierge-enhancer
description: Ranks your draft with skill-concierge while you type, so the skill menu the model reads is ready when you press Enter, and shows that menu on the line under the prompt. Draws nothing above the prompt, binds no key and never rewrites your prompt. Needs the skill-concierge plugin.

enabled.title: Rank drafts while typing
enabled.description: Off: the mod does nothing, and skill-concierge ranks each prompt when you send it, as without this mod. On: a settled draft of four words or more is sent to skill-concierge's ranker before you press Enter.

intent.title: Add a one-line intent to the ranking
intent.description: Experimental, off by default: it did not beat ranking the plain draft in the owner's blind comparison. On: asks the session's small model (haiku) for one sentence naming the work in your draft, and ranks the draft plus that sentence. The sentence goes to the ranker only, never to the prompt box or the model. Off: the draft is ranked alone.
